rows.text: - **REL-2** All telemetry MUST leave the device as OTLP sent to a configured Collector endpoint. An SDK MUST NOT send telemetry to any other destination or use a non-OTLP format.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'only OTLP to the configured endpoint'; live: Loki and Tempo
rows.note: Telemetry OTLP/HTTP JSON; replay OTLP/HTTP protobuf on /v1/logs

rows.text: - **REL-3** Attributes and events we define MUST be prefixed `ouo.`. Names that OTel defines, or that an official OTel SDK already emits, are used unprefixed. `[OPEN D1]`
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts checkRecord (attribute name allow-list on every record)

rows.text: - **REL-4** An SDK MUST NOT replace a tracer, logger or meter provider that the host has already registered globally, and it MUST NOT register its provider globally unless configured to.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'the exposed providers ... OTel globals are untouched', 'a host that registered its own OpenTelemetry first keeps it'
rows.note: Providers are global only with otel.registerGlobalProviders. A context manager and propagator are registered when the host has none (the OTel instrumentations need them)

rows.text: - **REL-5** The SDK MUST expose its OTel tracer and logger providers, so host instrumentation can emit through the same pipeline and receive the same session and view attributes.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'the exposed providers feed the same pipeline'

rows.text: - **REL-6** The SDK MUST NOT export client OTel metrics for RUM signals. Aggregates are derived at the edge from events. Short-lived clients do not fit the single-writer metric model ([Step 2](performance.md)).
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts (no /v1/metrics request)

rows.text: - **REL-7** Span events MUST NOT be used. Events go through the Logs API with a non-empty `EventName` (OTEP 4430).
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'one client span per request ... no events'
rows.note: Span events an instrumentation adds are removed before export

rows.text: - **API-1** Every public function MUST be safe to call before `init`, after `shutdown`, and on an unsupported platform. It MUST then be a no-op that does not throw.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/safety.test.ts 'every function is a no-op that does not throw before init', '... survives any argument'; ssr.test.ts

rows.text: - **API-2** A public function MUST NOT block the calling thread on I/O or network, and any waiting API MUST be asynchronous.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/safety.test.ts 'init does not wait for the network'
rows.note: Read: no public function awaits I/O; flush and shutdown are async. Not measured under a slow-storage stub

rows.text: - **API-3** `recordEvent` and attribute setters MUST reject app-supplied names in the reserved prefixes `session.` and `ouo.`, except attributes this spec lists as app-settable. A rejected name MUST be dropped, counted (**ERR-7**) and MUST NOT throw.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'rejects reserved names, counts them'

rows.text: - **API-4** Per-platform APIs SHOULD be named the same, apart from language casing.
rows.where: sdk/browser/src/index.ts exports
rows.note: The spec's function names

rows.text: - **API-5** `trackNavigation` MUST behave exactly like the equivalent automatic navigation, including new `ouo.view.id` assignment. If both report the same navigation, one signal MUST be emitted.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'trackNavigation names the navigation ... one signal', 'trackNavigation alone ...'

rows.text: - **API-6** `recordException` MUST set `ouo.exception.source=manual` and `ouo.exception.handled=true`, unless the caller set `handled`.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'recordException is manual and handled'

rows.text: - **CFG-1** Invalid configuration MUST NOT throw. An invalid value MUST fall back to its default with a diagnostic. If `endpoint` or `serviceName` is missing or invalid, the SDK MUST act as a no-op.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/core.test.ts 'is off, without throwing', 'clamps out-of-range values'

rows.text: - **CFG-2** Out-of-range values MUST be clamped: inactivity and background timeouts to at least 1 minute, maximum duration to at most 24 hours, rates to [0, 1].
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/core.test.ts 'clamps out-of-range values'

rows.text: - **CFG-3** `headers` values may be public ingest keys, and MUST NOT appear in URLs, records or diagnostics.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/core.test.ts 'builds the Authorization header ... never mentions it'; safety.test.ts 'with debug on, no part of the credential'

rows.text: - **CFG-4** A `beforeSend` hook MUST run before persistence and export. It MAY return a modified record or drop it, a hook that throws MUST be treated as returning the unmodified record, and it MUST NOT receive replay chunks.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'beforeSend runs on events and spans'; replay.test.ts (chunks never reach the hook)

rows.text: - **LIF-1** A second `init` MUST be ignored with a diagnostic.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/safety.test.ts 'a second init is ignored with a diagnostic'

rows.text: - **LIF-2** `init` MUST return without waiting for network, storage or a native bridge. Slow work continues asynchronously.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/safety.test.ts 'init does not wait for the network'

rows.text: - **LIF-3** Records created between `init` and storage readiness MUST be held in a bounded memory buffer, then processed normally.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts (records before the first flush are queued); queue bound in transport/queue.ts
rows.note: localStorage is synchronous; the outbox opens in the background and calls wait for it

rows.text: - **LIF-4** `shutdown` MUST stop all capture, remove every hook it installed, emit `session.end` if a session is active, close open replay streams (**RPL-20**), and attempt a flush bounded by `transport.shutdownDeadlineMs` (*default* 2 s).
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'shutdown ends the session'; safety.test.ts 'listeners, patches and timers are gone'; sdk/browser/e2e/locks.spec.ts (session.end at shutdown in three engines, last tab only)
rows.note: The web-vitals library offers no way to stop: its observers and listeners stay, inert, after shutdown

rows.text: - **LIF-5** After `shutdown`, `init` MAY be called again and MUST behave as a new start.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'shutdown ends the session ... and init works again'; safety.test.ts 'init and shutdown fifty times'

rows.text: - **LIF-6** An SDK MUST NOT register `unload` or `beforeunload` handlers, since they can disable the back/forward cache.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/version.test.ts 'no unload or beforeunload handler'

rows.text: - **LIF-7** At `pagehide`, in this order, the SDK MUST: end in-flight fetch and XHR spans with `ouo.span.abandoned=true` `[P18]`; emit remaining final vitals; close the current replay chunk and emit `ouo.replay.ended`; flush telemetry; then flush replay chunks with the remaining budget (**TRN-16**).
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'at page hide everything queued leaves at once'; sdk/browser/e2e/sdk.spec.ts 'page close: ... abandoned span'; replay.spec.ts 'page close ends the stream'

rows.text: - **LIF-8** On bfcache restore, the SDK MUST re-evaluate the session, assign a new `ouo.view.id`, restart vitals with new ids, and open a new replay stream starting with a keyframe.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'a page restored from the back/forward cache is a new view'
rows.note: Shown with a synthetic pageshow(persisted); a real bfcache restore was not driven in a browser

rows.text: - **LIF-9** On a server-side or non-DOM runtime, the web SDK MUST be a no-op. Importing it MUST NOT throw or touch DOM globals at module load.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/ssr.test.ts; sdk/browser/scripts/compat.mjs (imports dist in Node)

rows.text: - **LIF-10** A prerendered page MUST NOT start a session or send telemetry until it activates.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'a prerendered page starts no session'
rows.note: Shown by stubbing document.prerendering; a real prerender was not driven in a browser

rows.text: - **SES-1** `session.id` MUST be 128 bits from a cryptographically secure generator, written as 32 lowercase hex characters. Consumers MUST treat it as opaque.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/core.test.ts 'session ids are 32 lowercase hex'
rows.note: crypto.getRandomValues; without it the SDK stays off

rows.text: - **SES-2** `session.id` MUST be a record attribute on every log record and span, stamped when the record is created, not at export. It MUST NOT be a resource attribute.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts checkRecord, 'restartSession links the sessions' (stamped at creation across a rollover)

rows.text: - **SES-3** A session MUST start on the first activity with no valid session. `init` in a visible page or foregrounded app counts as activity.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/session.test.ts 'a visible init starts a session; a hidden one waits'
rows.note: A navigation counts as activity only in a visible page

rows.text: - **SES-4** In a sampled session (**SMP-3**), `session.start` MUST be emitted exactly once, as the session's first record, with `session.id`, and with `session.previous_id` whenever a prior session id is known, except after consent withdrawal (**PRV-4**). `session.previous_id` MUST differ from `session.id` and MUST NOT appear on other records.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'session.start is the first record', 'restartSession ...'; sdk/browser/e2e/sdk.spec.ts 'two tabs ...'

rows.text: - **SES-5** Only these count as activity. Web: pointer down, key down, wheel or touch scroll, hard or soft navigation, and a page becoming visible. Mobile: touch, a screen navigation, and a move to foreground. Telemetry, timers and network activity MUST NOT count.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/session.test.ts 'stamps do not extend the session'; wire.test.ts 'requests do not extend the session'

rows.text: - **SES-6** The last-activity time SHOULD be written to storage at most once per 5 s per context.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/session.test.ts 'writes last activity at most once per 5 s'

rows.text: - **SES-7** `session.end` SHOULD be emitted, before the following `session.start`, with the timestamp of the last activity and with `ouo.session.end_reason` (`timeout`, `max_duration`, `manual`, `shutdown`, `consent`).
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/session.test.ts 'activity after the timeout ends the old session at its last activity'

rows.text: - **SES-9** Reaching `maxDurationMs` with the user present MUST roll to a new session at once, with `session.previous_id` linking them.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/session.test.ts 'reaching the maximum duration ... rolls at once'

rows.text: - **SES-10** While no valid session exists, records outside the bypass set MUST be dropped and counted with reason `no_session`. A polling tab MUST NOT create sessions. Bypass-set records MUST be sent with the last session id and `ouo.session.expired=true`. If no session id is known, for example a crash during a background launch, the SDK MUST generate one for those records, also marked, without emitting `session.start`.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/session.test.ts 'a polling tab makes none'; wire.test.ts 'without a valid session ...'

rows.text: - **SES-11** One session MUST be shared by all same-origin tabs in a browser profile, stored in `localStorage`. Starting, ending and rolling MUST be serialised with Web Locks where available. Otherwise a tab MUST write, re-read and adopt the stored value. Exactly one context MUST emit each `session.start` and `session.end`.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/session.test.ts 'two tabs share one session and emit one start'; review.test.ts (asynchronous lock); sdk/browser/e2e/sdk.spec.ts 'two tabs share one session'; locks.spec.ts (one end across two tabs)
rows.note: Web Lock where available; write, re-read and adopt always

rows.text: - **SES-12** Where `localStorage` is unavailable, the session lives in memory and is limited to the page. The SDK MUST NOT fall back to cookies.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/session.test.ts 'blocked storage falls back to memory'; sdk/browser/e2e/faults.spec.ts 'storage blocked by the browser'

rows.text: - **SIG-00** A signal in these tables MUST be emitted with its type, name, required attributes and firing rule whenever the platform supports it, the instrumentation is enabled and the session is sampled.
rows.where: The SIG rows below; live: examples/ouo-web/scripts/verify.py

rows.text: - **REC-1** Every event MUST set `EventName`. It MUST NOT set the deprecated `event.name` attribute.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts checkRecord

rows.text: - **REC-2** Every record MUST carry `session.id` (**SES-2**), and `ouo.view.id` once a view exists. `ouo.view.id` is a new random id for every hard or soft navigation and screen view. `[OPEN D5]` `[P13]`
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts checkRecord, 'one browser.navigation ... each with a new view id'

rows.text: - **REC-3** Every web record except those in the `ouo.replay` scope MUST carry sanitised `browser.document.url.full`. Mobile records SHOULD carry `app.screen.name` when known.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts checkRecord

rows.text: - **REC-4** `Timestamp` MUST be when the thing occurred, and `ObservedTimestamp` when the SDK recorded it.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts checkRecord (observed >= time); session.end at last activity

rows.text: - **REC-5** Telemetry MUST use instrumentation scope `ouo.rum`. Replay records MUST use scope `ouo.replay` (**RPL-3**). Both MUST set `schema_url` (**VER-3**) `[P19]`. Host-provided OTel instrumentations keep their own scope.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts checkRecord; replay.test.ts checkStream
rows.note: The bundled fetch/XHR instrumentations get the ouo.rum tracer

rows.text: - **REC-6** Spans MUST be used only for network calls, `documentLoad` and `AppStart`. The two load spans MUST be created after the fact with explicit times, so they are never open.
rows.where: sdk/browser/e2e/sdk.spec.ts 'document load: one span after the fact'; wire.test.ts 'requests ... clicks do not parent them'

rows.text: - **REC-7** Every event defaults to severity INFO unless its table says otherwise.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts (INFO default, exception ERROR)
rows.note: ouo.sdk.disabled is WARN

rows.text: - **REC-8** Attribute values MUST be truncated at source: `exception.stacktrace` to 25 KiB keeping the top frames, other strings to 4 KiB. Total attributes on a record SHOULD stay under 64 KB, the Loki metadata limit.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/core.test.ts 'truncates strings at 4 KiB and stacks at 25 KiB'

rows.text: - **REC-9** The SDK MUST NOT estimate clock offset. Records carry the device clock, and edge validation handles skew ([rules](rules.md)).
rows.where: No clock offset code

rows.text: - **RES-0** The resource MUST carry the attributes marked MUST in this table, for that platform.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'resource: service, SDK identity and environment only'
rows.note: user_agent.original is dropped when browser.brands exists

rows.text: - **RES-1** The resource MUST contain only low-cardinality identity fixed for the SDK's lifetime.
rows.where: Same test

rows.text: - **RES-2** `service.instance.id`, `app.installation.id` and `device.id` MUST NOT be on the resource. `device.id` MUST NOT be sent at all unless configured. `[OPEN D4]`
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts checkRecord (forbidden resource attributes); no device id anywhere

rows.text: - **RES-3** `session.id`, `ouo.view.id`, `app.screen.name`, `browser.document.url.full` and `enduser.*` MUST NOT be on the resource.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts checkRecord

rows.text: - **RES-4** The SDK MUST NOT depend on OTel entities until the entity spec is stable. `[P17]`
rows.where: No entity API used

rows.text: - **PRP-1** The SDK MUST use W3C Trace Context on instrumented requests whose URL matches `propagation.urls`. Trace ids MUST be random.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'traceparent goes to the same origin and to configured URLs only'

rows.text: - **PRP-2** Web MUST inject cross-origin only on an explicit match, since the server must allow the header in CORS.
rows.where: Same test; review.test.ts 'a reused init does not carry the SDK's trace header to an origin outside the allow-list'

rows.text: - **PRP-3** The SDK MUST NOT inject if the request already has `traceparent`.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'an app-set traceparent and baggage are never overwritten', 'XHR: an app-set traceparent is kept'

rows.text: - **PRP-4** The sampled flag MUST reflect the session's decision (**SMP-4**).
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts '... sampled flag clear (SMP-4)'

rows.text: - **PRP-5** Web SHOULD read `<meta name="traceparent">` and use it as the parent of `documentLoad` only. It MUST NOT apply it to any other record. `[OPEN D2]`
rows.where: sdk/browser/e2e/sdk.spec.ts 'document load ...'

rows.text: - **PRP-6** When `propagation.sessionBaggage` is true, the SDK MUST send W3C `baggage: session.id=<id>`, only to URLs that receive trace headers, with the same value as the record attribute. It MUST be off by default. `[OPEN D4]` `[P14]`
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'session baggage is sent only when configured'; live: backend spans carry session.id

rows.text: - **TRN-1** Export MUST be OTLP/HTTP as defined by OTLP v1.11.1. Replay chunks MUST use binary protobuf, to avoid the 4/3 base64 cost.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts; replay.test.ts (application/x-protobuf)
rows.note: Telemetry stays JSON with gzip, as Step 5 recommended

rows.text: - **TRN-2** Non-replay requests SHOULD be gzipped. Where compression is asynchronous and cannot finish during page teardown, the unload flush MAY be uncompressed and counts uncompressed against **TRN-16**.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts (gzip when large; uncompressed at page hide)

rows.text: - **TRN-3** Telemetry and replay MUST have separate queues and separate export tasks. Replay failure, backlog or size MUST NOT delay telemetry.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'a stalled replay endpoint does not delay telemetry'

rows.text: - **TRN-4** A request MUST NOT exceed `maxRequestBytes` or `maxBatchRecords`. An empty request MUST NOT be sent.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'no request is sent when there is nothing to send, and batches respect maxBatchRecords'

rows.text: - **TRN-5** Each replay chunk MUST be sent as its own request, so a partial-success count identifies the chunk without ambiguity.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts (one request per chunk)

rows.text: - **TRN-6** Retries MUST follow that table.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/core.test.ts status table; wire.test.ts 'retries 503 ..., drops 400 ..., honours partial success'

rows.text: - **TRN-7** Backoff MUST be exponential with full jitter, from `retry.initialMs` to `retry.maxMs`.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/core.test.ts 'backoff is exponential with full jitter'

rows.text: - **TRN-8** `Retry-After` MUST be honoured, capped at `retry.maxMs`.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/core.test.ts 'Retry-After is honoured and capped'

rows.text: - **TRN-9** An in-memory batch MUST be retried until the queue limit forces eviction, then dropped and counted.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'a full queue evicts the oldest ordinary records first'

rows.text: - **TRN-10** Retries MUST reuse the original payload. Delivery is at-least-once, so duplicates are expected. Identity for de-duplication is `(ouo.replay.id, ouo.replay.stream.id, ouo.replay.sequence)` for chunks, `span_id` for spans, `app.crash.id` for crashes, `browser.web_vital.id` for vitals.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts (identical retry bytes); replay.test.ts 'retries reuse the bytes'; review.test.ts 'a batch is delivered once' (one owner per failed batch)

rows.text: - **TRN-11** When the export queue is full, the SDK MUST evict the oldest non-bypass records first and count each.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'a full queue ... keeps unhandled errors'

rows.text: - **TRN-12** Data is **durably accepted** only when the configured endpoint answers 2xx with no rejected records. A persisted record MUST NOT be deleted before then, except for the reasons in **TRN-13**.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'persisted before its first send and removed only after a 2xx'

rows.text: - **TRN-13** A persisted record MAY be deleted early only for: a non-retryable response; expiry of `persist.ttlHours`; storage cap reached; consent withdrawal; an app-initiated clear; or corrupt data. Each except consent and clear MUST be counted.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'the memory outbox honours the cap, the time to live'; drops counted

rows.text: - **TRN-14** Under the storage cap, eviction MUST run oldest-first in this order: replay chunks, then ordinary telemetry, then bypass-set records.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'evicts replay first, then telemetry, then bypass records'

rows.text: - **TRN-20** Data MUST be persisted as this table requires.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts; sdk/browser/e2e/replay.spec.ts 'collector down: chunks wait in IndexedDB'

rows.text: - **TRN-15** Persistence MUST NOT run on the main thread on mobile. On the web it MUST be asynchronous. Persistence failure MUST degrade to memory-only and be counted.
rows.where: sdk/browser/e2e/faults.spec.ts ('storage and the outbox throw', 'storage blocked by the browser')
rows.note: IndexedDB is asynchronous; a failure degrades to memory and is counted

rows.text: - **TRN-16** Unload flushes MUST use `fetch` with `keepalive` and keep all in-flight keepalive bytes at or under 60 KiB (the platform limit is 64 KiB across all requests). Telemetry goes first. A replay chunk is sent only if it fits in what remains. Chunks that do not fit stay persisted.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'at page hide ... with keepalive, errors first' (total under 60 KiB); replay.test.ts 'page hide'

rows.text: - **TRN-17** `sendBeacon` MAY be used as a fallback, and MUST NOT carry credentials in the URL.
rows.where: sendBeacon is not used

rows.text: - **TRN-18** A persisted replay chunk from a closed page MUST be sent by a later page of the same origin. A page claims a closed stream through a Web Lock, so only one page drains it.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'a later page sends what a dead page left behind'; sdk/browser/e2e/replay.spec.ts
rows.note: Web Lock per stream

rows.text: - **TRN-19** Because a keepalive response may never be observed, a chunk sent at unload MUST stay persisted until a later page confirms acceptance by resend. Muninn de-duplicates by chunk identity.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'page hide: ... stored with the end record'; sdk/browser/e2e/replay.spec.ts 'collector down ...'
rows.note: The stored copy is deleted when a 2xx is observed, by this page or a later one (TRN-12); it stays when no answer is seen

rows.text: - **SMP-1** Sampling MUST be decided once per session, at session start, and persisted with the session. `[P15]`
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/session.test.ts 'the sampling decision is made once from the id and stored'

rows.text: - **SMP-2** The decision MUST be deterministic from `session.id`: sampled when the first 8 hex characters, read as an unsigned 32-bit integer, divided by 2^32, is below `sampling.sessionRate`. All tabs, and JS and native in RN, then agree.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/core.test.ts 'golden vectors'

rows.text: - **SMP-3** An unsampled session MUST emit only the bypass set. `session.start` itself MUST NOT be emitted. `ouo.session.sample_rate` on `session.start` lets consumers scale counts.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'an unsampled session sends only unhandled errors'

rows.text: - **SMP-4** Spans in a sampled session MUST have the sampled flag set. Requests in an unsampled session MUST still propagate `traceparent`, with the flag clear.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'the request still carries traceparent with the sampled flag clear'

rows.text: - **SMP-5** The bypass set MUST be: `app.crash`, `device.anr`, `ouo.app.hang`, and `exception` with `ouo.exception.handled=false`.
rows.where: Same as SMP-3

rows.text: - **SMP-6** Bypass records from an unsampled session MUST carry `ouo.sampling.bypass=true`, and consumers MUST exclude them from rates and session health, whose denominator is sampled sessions only. Without this exclusion, those rates would be biased upward.
rows.where: Same as SMP-3 (ouo.sampling.bypass)

rows.text: - **SMP-7** At most `sampling.bypass.perSessionCap` bypass records MUST be sent per unsampled session. Crashes MUST NOT be capped, as there is at most one per session.
rows.where: Same as SMP-3 (cap, counted)

rows.text: - **SMP-8** Replay sampling MUST use the second 8 hex characters of `session.id`, by the same method as **SMP-2**, so it is independent of the session decision.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/core.test.ts 'golden vectors', 'the two decisions are independent'

rows.text: - **SMP-9** Replay MUST run only in sampled sessions. To keep replays for rare errors, set `sessionRate` to 1.0 and use a low replay rate.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'does not record: session not sampled'
rows.note: The option that picks session or buffer recording is the pair of rates, not the spec's replay.mode (ADR-0020)

rows.text: - **SMP-10** In `buffer` mode, the SDK MUST hold at least the last `replay.bufferSeconds` (*default* 60) in a ring that always retains the keyframe needed to decode it. Evicting whole segments is the only permitted eviction.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'the buffer ring keeps whole segments'

rows.text: - **SMP-11** Web MUST keep the ring in memory only, so nothing that was never triggered reaches disk. Mobile MAY persist the ring so a crash can trigger upload on next launch, and if it does it MUST discard unused rings at next launch.
rows.where: Same test (nothing stored or sent before a trigger)

rows.text: - **SMP-12** A trigger is any bypass-set record or `replay.capture()`. The buffer MUST then be flushed and recording MUST continue as in `session` mode until the session ends, with `ouo.replay.mode=buffer` and `ouo.replay.trigger` set.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'buffer mode sends nothing until an unhandled error', 'replay.capture()'; sdk/browser/e2e/replay.spec.ts

rows.text: - **PRV-1** When `consent.required` is true, the SDK MUST start with consent pending. While pending it MUST NOT send anything, MUST NOT write to persistent storage, and MUST NOT start replay.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'pending: nothing is sent or stored'; sdk/browser/e2e/sdk.spec.ts 'consent pending' (no IndexedDB database either)

rows.text: - **PRV-2** Records created while pending MAY be held in a bounded memory buffer. On grant they MUST be processed normally. On denial they MUST be discarded.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'pending ...', 'denied while pending'; review.test.ts 'records held for the start are not sent'

rows.text: - **PRV-3** Telemetry and replay consent MUST be separate. Replay MUST require replay consent.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'replay consent missing', 'replay consent starts recording'

rows.text: - **PRV-4** On withdrawal, the SDK MUST stop capture of that category, emit nothing further for it, delete unsent persisted data for it, and clear the persisted session. A later grant MUST start a new session without `session.previous_id`.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'withdrawal ends the session with reason consent'; sdk/browser/e2e/locks.spec.ts (consent end emitted, nothing sent afterwards, two tabs)
rows.note: A replay stream whose consent is withdrawn gets no end record: nothing more may be emitted

rows.text: - **PRV-5** Replay MUST mask by default. Web: all text and all input values masked; images, video and canvas blocked. Mobile: all text and images masked. Masking MUST happen on the device, before any persistence or export.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'masks text as ***'; sdk/browser/e2e/replay.spec.ts (secrets searched in the output)

rows.text: - **PRV-6** Web apps unmask or mask through `data-ouo-unmask` and `data-ouo-mask`. Mask MUST win when both apply. Password, payment and one-time-code fields MUST always be masked and MUST NOT be unmaskable.
rows.where: Same tests (data-ouo-unmask, data-ouo-mask wins, password / card / one-time-code never unmasked)

rows.text: - **PRV-8** If masking fails or the masked state of a frame cannot be established, the frame MUST be dropped, not sent.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'a frame the adapter could not mask'; sdk/browser/e2e/faults.spec.ts ('replay cannot load or mask')

rows.text: - **PRV-9** Defaults: `browser.tag_name`, sanitised `browser.css_selector` and the sanitised INP target are on. `app.widget.id` is on. `app.widget.name` and the web-vital attribution body are off. Selectors MUST be built from tag names, `nth-of-type`, and ids only, MUST NOT contain attribute values, and MUST omit any id containing a run of 6 or more digits, since such ids are often generated or user-specific.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/core.test.ts 'uses tags, nth-of-type and ids only'

rows.text: - **PRV-10** URLs on `url.full`, `browser.document.url.full`, stack frames and replay MUST be sanitised before persistence: credentials become `REDACTED:REDACTED`; every query value becomes `REDACTED` unless its key is in `privacy.urlQueryAllow`; the fragment is removed unless `privacy.keepUrlFragment`. A `sanitizeUrl` hook then runs. This is stricter than the OTel default, which redacts only listed keys.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/core.test.ts URL vectors; wire.test.ts (url.full, document URL, code.file.path); replay.test.ts (page and link URLs)

rows.text: - **PRV-11** Sanitising MUST also cover a query-shaped fragment if fragments are kept.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/core.test.ts 'keeps allowed query keys and ... a sanitised fragment'

rows.text: - **PRV-12** The SDK MUST NOT capture request or response bodies or headers, apart from those required by the HTTP conventions.
rows.where: No body or header capture exists

rows.text: - **PRV-13** `enduser.id` and `enduser.pseudo.id` MUST be sent only after `setUser`. The SDK MUST NOT collect IP address, location, advertising id or contacts.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'enduser.id appears only after setUser'; review.test.ts 'the cleared user does not come back' (two tabs)

rows.text: - **PRV-14** `exception.message` and `.stacktrace` pass through `beforeSend`. Apps with sensitive messages are expected to use it.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'beforeSend ...' (exception message scrubbed)

rows.text: - **RPL-1** Every chunk MUST carry all identity attributes in [section 11.3](#113-chunk-record).
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts checkStream

rows.text: - **RPL-2** A chunk is an OTLP log record, with bytes as its body when sent to the Collector. `[OPEN D3]` `[P16]`
rows.where: Same (log record, bytes body)

rows.text: - **RPL-3** Chunks and end records MUST use scope `ouo.replay`, so the Collector can route them to a separate pipeline.
rows.where: Same (scope ouo.replay)

rows.text: - **RPL-4** `ouo.replay.sequence` MUST start at 0 in each stream and rise by exactly 1 per chunk. It MUST NOT reset at a segment boundary, and retransmission MUST reuse the same value and the same bytes.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'a keyframe starts a new chunk and a new segment; sequence never resets'

rows.text: - **RPL-5** A stream MUST map to exactly one tab, window, scene or process lifetime.
rows.where: One stream per page lifetime; new stream after stop/start and for the next page

rows.text: - **RPL-6** The first chunk of a segment MUST have `ouo.replay.keyframe=true`, and it MUST start with a keyframe that makes the segment decodable with no earlier data. A keyframe MAY span chunks.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts checkStream, keyframe test

rows.text: - **RPL-7** The concatenation of a segment's decompressed chunk bodies, in sequence order, MUST be a valid payload of `ouo.replay.format`. Each chunk body MUST be independently decompressible.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'a chunk larger than the limit is split ... the concatenation is the payload'
rows.note: Both formats are streams of self-delimiting units

rows.text: - **RPL-8** After any gap in capture or local loss, the SDK MUST start a new segment with a keyframe before sending more.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'a chunk refused with 400 ... a new keyframe first', 'after a rejected chunk the rest of its segment is not sent'

rows.text: - **RPL-9** A new keyframe and segment SHOULD begin at least every `replay.keyframeIntervalMs` (*default* 300 000), and on a change of tab visibility or foreground.
rows.where: Keyframe timer and on visible (replay/engine.ts)
rows.note: SHOULD

rows.text: - **RPL-10** A chunk MUST be closed at the earliest of: `replay.chunkMaxBytes` (*default* 256 KiB compressed; hard limit 1 MiB), `replay.chunkMaxMs` (*default* 5000), stream end, or page hide or background.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts (time, size, stream end, page hide)

rows.text: - **RPL-11** Chunk bodies MUST NOT exceed the hard limit, and a larger chunk MUST be split, never truncated.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts split test (bodies under the limit)

rows.text: - **RPL-12** `ouo.replay.sha256` MUST be the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact body bytes as sent, after compression.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts checkStream (hash recomputed); 'the synchronous SHA-256 agrees'

rows.text: - **RPL-13** Attributes marked MUST in that table MUST be present on every chunk.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts checkStream (REQUIRED list)

rows.text: - **RPL-14** An SDK MUST NOT set `ouo.replay.ref`.
rows.where: Same (no ouo.replay.ref)

rows.text: - **RPL-15** A chunk MUST be persisted before its first send where storage is available (web: IndexedDB; mobile: disk).
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'the request for a chunk leaves only after the outbox has it'
rows.note: At page close the write and the keepalive request start in the same task: nothing can be awaited there

rows.text: - **RPL-16** Chunks of one stream SHOULD be sent in sequence order. Receivers MUST NOT assume arrival order.
rows.where: One sequential send queue per stream

rows.text: - **RPL-17** A backlog MUST drop or evict whole chunks from the oldest segment. It MUST mark the stream partial (**RPL-21**) and MUST NOT silently renumber.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'a backlog drops whole chunks of the oldest segment'

rows.text: - **RPL-18** Replay capture MUST stop, and the stream MUST be marked partial, if the replay queue and store are full and cannot accept more.
rows.where: Same test (capture stops, reason max_size)

rows.text: - **RPL-19** Replay capture MUST NOT run in a session where replay was not sampled or consented.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'does not record: ...'

rows.text: - **RPL-26** Every `ouo.replay.ended` record MUST carry the attributes marked MUST in this table.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts (ended attributes)

rows.text: - **RPL-20** An SDK MUST emit `ouo.replay.ended` when a stream ends normally. A killed process cannot emit it, so on next launch the SDK MUST emit it for streams left open, with `end_state=partial`.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'a later page ... says the stream ended partial', 'recovering a dead page's stream does not disturb the stream this page records'; sdk/browser/e2e/replay.spec.ts
rows.note: Exception by PRV-4: a stream whose consent is withdrawn is discarded without an end record

rows.text: - **RPL-21** `end_state=complete` MUST mean only that chunks 0 to `last_sequence` were all produced and none is known to have been lost or rejected. The SDK cannot see the whole path, so this is a claim about the client.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts (partial after a rejected chunk, a dropped frame, a backlog)

rows.text: - **RPL-27** Every format adapter MUST provide the capabilities in this table.
rows.where: sdk/browser/src/replay/adapter.ts; the structure adapter and a stub pass the same engine

rows.text: - **RPL-23** The hierarchy, identity, chunk attributes, delivery and end rules MUST NOT depend on the format.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/replay.test.ts 'engine contract with a stub format'

rows.text: - **ERR-1** The SDK MUST NOT crash, hang or throw into the host app. Every callback, patched function, observer and handler MUST catch its own errors.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/safety.test.ts (fault at every point); sdk/browser/e2e/faults.spec.ts (transcript equal with the SDK off and under every fault)

rows.text: - **ERR-2** Patched platform functions (`fetch`, `XMLHttpRequest`, history methods, delegates, interceptors) MUST preserve the original's behaviour, return values, errors and timing semantics.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'the patched history methods behave like the originals'; safety.test.ts

rows.text: - **ERR-3** Global error and crash handlers MUST chain to any previous handler and MUST NOT swallow the error.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/safety.test.ts 'the app's own error handlers still run'

rows.text: - **ERR-4** The SDK MUST NOT do synchronous disk or network I/O on the UI thread. Web MUST NOT use synchronous XHR.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/version.test.ts (no synchronous XHR)
rows.note: localStorage reads and writes are synchronous and small, as the spec's own SES-11 requires

rows.text: - **ERR-5** Instrumentation and exporters MUST NOT re-enter themselves.
rows.where: Exports are not traced; drop events are not counted as drops

rows.text: - **ERR-6** After `diagnostics.selfDisableThreshold` (*default* 20) internal errors in one process lifetime, the SDK MUST stop capture and act as a no-op. Crash reporting MAY continue.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/safety.test.ts 'after the threshold of internal errors ...'; review.test.ts 'shutdown() then init() without awaiting'

rows.text: - **ERR-7** The SDK MUST count every record it drops, by signal and reason. It MUST report counts as event `ouo.sdk.dropped` with `ouo.sdk.drop.reason`, `ouo.sdk.drop.signal` and `ouo.sdk.drop.count`, at most once per flush interval. Drop events MUST NOT count as drops themselves or cause more drop events.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts 'a flood of errors is rate limited and the drops are reported'; core.test.ts

rows.text: - **ERR-8** Diagnostics MUST go to the platform console only when `debug` is on. They MUST NOT include record payloads.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/safety.test.ts 'with debug on ...', 'with debug off the SDK prints nothing'

rows.text: - **ERR-9** All internal buffers MUST be bounded.
rows.where: Every queue, ring, map and set has a bound (emitter, queue, engine, drops)

rows.text: - **VER-2** Each SDK release MUST state the spec version it implements.
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/version.test.ts (SPEC_VERSION, README, package.json ouo.specVersion)

rows.text: - **VER-3** Every scope MUST set `schema_url` to the version whose names it emits. For this draft, `https://opentelemetry.io/schemas/client-side-dev/0.1.0-dev`, which is pinned to core 1.45.0. `[P19]`
rows.where: sdk/browser/test/wire.test.ts checkRecord; replay.test.ts checkStream
